# Security Policy

## Reporting

Do not post credentials, private keys, tokens, personal data, customer data,
NDA-covered information, or sensitive exploit details in a public GitHub Issue.

For ordinary content errors and broken links, use GitHub Issues with only
public information.

For a vulnerability in the repository/site itself, use GitHub's private
vulnerability reporting / Security Advisory feature when available. If private
reporting is unavailable, open a minimal public Issue that does not include
exploit details or secrets and request a private follow-up channel.

## Scope

This policy covers the Security Intelligence Library repository, build scripts,
GitHub Actions workflow, and generated site configuration. Third-party products
discussed in articles are outside this repository's security-reporting scope.
